# HWRawInputs

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HWRawInputs:Int32
```

**Returns:** 1 if raw mouse input is available, otherwise 0.

## Description

Tells whether this platform has a mouse that [RawInputs](RawInputs) can ask for without the acceleration of the system. That is the case on Windows, Linux (X11 and Wayland) and macOS with a mouse attached, and not where there is no window system or no mouse. Where it is 0, RawInputs is accepted and changes nothing.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
